answer: Identity bond decay stops fake identities. Each agent posts a bond worth twice 30 days of earnings, locked for 20 epochs, for the harbor registry. It decays 5% each idle epoch, so a dormant jade credential falls down a terrace. A random audit replays one past job; failure burns the bond and bars it for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, or 6,000 days of earnings, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
